name: henry-focus
description: ADHD-friendly focus layer for research, coding, debugging, and technical work.

interface.longDescription: Reduce cognitive switching while preserving technical depth. Henry Focus leads with conclusions, separates evidence from interpretation, and makes the next action explicit for research, coding, debugging, and complex tasks.
defaultPrompt: Analyze this research problem: conclusion, evidence, uncertainty, next test.
Debug this issue: problem, cause, fix, verification.
